statement: In a prospective multicentre cohort of acute cervical spinal cord injury, decompression within 24 hours was associated with a higher rate of two-grade or greater neurological improvement at six months than later surgery.

measurement.effect: higher odds of >=2 grade improvement with early surgery

replication.note: One prospective multicentre cohort; not randomised, and timing is confounded by injury severity and access to care.

limitations: observational: patients operated early may differ systematically
no randomised trial of timing exists

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
